about.title: Scans That Turn Into Decisions
about.body: Airix is a SaaS platform that helps growers digitize their fields and reduce uncertainty. Using mobile, drone, or multispectral scans, we convert imagery into practical outputs—counts, yield estimates, and early risk signals so you can prioritize actions, plan harvest, and protect production.

faq.title: Questions & Answers
faq.subtitle: We answer the most common questions about our platform and how it works in the field.

services.title: All your field data in your pocket just focus on execution
services.desc: Free up hours of manual labor in data collection: cacao pod counting, phytosanitary disease detection, and more, directly from the field.

services.title: Automate weed control in your fields
services.desc: Use our autonomous rover to cut weeds in specific areas of your farm while it scans the real-time health of your crops.

services.title: Turn field data into actionable decisions
services.desc: Get dense, high-precision soil analysis across your entire farm to make better decisions on fertilization, irrigation, and crop management.

faq_items.title: How does the system work?
faq_items.desc: The rover integrates RGB cameras, LiDAR, environmental sensors, and an embedded computing unit to run our computer vision models. It detects diseases, counts cacao pods, and analyzes crop conditions in real time directly in the field.

faq_items.title: What technology powers the platform?
faq_items.desc: Our solution combines artificial intelligence, convolutional neural networks, and RGB imaging to classify cacao health status, estimate yield, and generate actionable agronomic insights for farmers and agribusiness stakeholders.

faq_items.title: How can farmers implement the system?
faq_items.desc: The platform is designed for seamless deployment in cacao farms. Once installed, the rover autonomously navigates the plantation, collects field data, and synchronizes results to a centralized dashboard for monitoring and decision-making.

faq_items.title: What happens after data is collected?
faq_items.desc: Captured data is processed through our predictive analytics engine. Farmers receive reports on disease risk, production estimates, and soil condition indicators, enabling early intervention, optimized resource use, and improved productivity.
